verdict.rationale: First-party self-hosting docs say Letta agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control. The App Server deploys the agent harness as a service on your own always-on machine, with all state (messages, memory, provider connections) kept on-device and no Letta account required. The CLI's default local mode likewise stores state locally without login. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and evidence that cloud-tied features such as shared memory (hosted in Letta Cloud) work in self-hosted mode.
